title: Confirm RMS robotControl screen loads during Services Unplanned restart (before UPS removes master estop)
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI to confirm the robotControl/monitor screen fully loads before proceeding with the Services Unplanned restart sequence timing that is tied to UPS removing the master estop.
when_to_use: When performing (or preparing to perform) the Services Unplanned restart sequence and you must verify the RMS robotControl/monitor screen is reachable and fully loads before the UPS-related step involving master estop removal.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the live RMS UI check (login and confirm the robotControl/monitor view loads).
L2_support: Support escalation if RMS robotControl/monitor does not load (connectivity/service troubleshooting).
safety_notes: Do not proceed to the UPS/master estop timing step if the RMS robotControl/monitor screen fails to load or remains in a loading/error state.
access_or_tools_needed: Browser access to the RMS URL path fragment ending in "monitor/robotControl"

access_required: RMS access via the site/FORTNA credentials workflow used for RMS
system_preconditions: RMS web UI is reachable from the support workstation

visual_references.description: Training frame showing the RMS URL path fragment ending in "monitor/robotControl" and the instruction text tying screen load to the Services Unplanned restart timing before UPS removes the master estop.

steps.title: Open RMS / fleet status UI to the robotControl monitor path
steps.purpose: Ensure you are on the correct RMS view (robotControl/monitor) before validating that it loads.
steps.instruction: In a browser, open the RMS / fleet status UI using the RMS URL path fragment shown in the reference that ends with "monitor/robotControl".
steps.expected_result: The browser navigates to the RMS robotControl/monitor view (URL path includes "monitor/robotControl").
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS robotControl/monitor view route is reached (no immediate navigation error).
steps.failure_condition: Navigation fails or the URL does not reach the robotControl/monitor view.

actions.label: Navigate to robotControl monitor path
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI in a browser using the RMS URL path shown in the slide (path fragment includes "monitor/robotControl").

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot reach the robotControl/monitor path, stop and escalate for RMS connectivity/service troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR includes an RMS URL with a path fragment ending in "monitor/robotControl" under the heading "Services Unplanned restart".

steps.title: Log into RMS
steps.purpose: Authenticate so the robotControl/monitor view can load.
steps.instruction: Log into RMS using the site/FORTNA credentials workflow you normally use for RMS access.
steps.expected_result: You are authenticated in RMS and the robotControl/monitor view can begin loading.
steps.healthy_condition: No authentication error is shown; the robotControl/monitor page proceeds to load.
steps.failure_condition: Login/authentication fails or blocks access to the robotControl/monitor view.

actions.label: Login to RMS
actions.exact_action: Log into RMS (use the site/FORTNA credentials workflow you normally use for RMS access).

stop_or_escalate_if: If login fails, stop and escalate for RMS access/authentication troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Instruction text: "Log into RMS and confirm the screen ... loads".

steps.title: Wait for robotControl/monitor screen to fully load
steps.purpose: Confirm the RMS robotControl/monitor view is actually loaded (not blank/loading/error) before proceeding with the Services Unplanned restart timing step.
steps.instruction: Wait for the robotControl/monitor screen to fully load until the page finishes loading and the robotControl view elements are visible (not blank, not stuck loading, not showing an error state).
steps.expected_result: The RMS robotControl/monitor view loads successfully and is visibly present in the RMS UI (not blank, not stuck loading, not showing an error).
steps.healthy_condition: RobotControl view elements are visible and the page is not in a persistent loading state or error state.
steps.failure_condition: Blank page, persistent loading, or an error state persists on the robotControl/monitor view.

actions.label: Confirm screen load success
actions.exact_action: Wait for the robotControl/monitor screen to fully load (page finishes loading; the robotControl view elements are visible rather than a blank/loading/error state).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robotControl screen does not load (blank page, persistent loading, or an error state), stop and escalate for RMS connectivity/service troubleshooting rather than proceeding with the UPS/master estop timing step.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Instruction text: "Log into RMS and confirm the screen ... loads before having UPS remove the ... master estop".

success_criteria: robotControl/monitor view is visibly present in RMS UI (not blank, not stuck loading, not showing an error).
healthy_conditions: RMS robotControl/monitor page finishes loading and shows robotControl view elements.
failure_conditions: robotControl/monitor page is blank, remains in loading, or shows an error state.
escalation_guidance: If the robotControl screen fails to load or remains in a loading/error state, stop and escalate for RMS connectivity/service troubleshooting rather than proceeding with the UPS/master estop timing step.
